confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live booking pages or listings were checked. USD values are sensitive to shekel moves. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain given seasonal and security-driven demand swings. Beer assumes a roughly 0.5 L domestic draft. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (about 1.4x and 1.2x) because direct price knowledge is weaker. FX: 13 Oct 2026 RBA reading taken from search excerpts of the RBA overview page; the table itself was not opened, and no 14 Oct value was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Middle East regional basis, using Tel Aviv's own high price level. Restaurant and cafe anchors are benchmarked to high-cost Western European and Mediterranean city centres; hostel and hotel anchors to mid-range tourist accommodation in comparable Mediterranean cities. Jerusalem and Haifa are lower-cost domestic reference points.
